audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Joshua / Yehoshua Levitical city distribution and rest-summary register, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Levite petition, Moses-command fulfillment, Kohath/Gershon/Merari lots, priestly cities, refuge cities, pasturelands, forty-eight-city total, and fulfillment/rest formula.

verses.restored: Heads of fathers' houses of Levites drew near to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and heads of fathers' houses of tribes of children of Israel.

familiar.text: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;

modern.text: Now the family heads of the Levites approached Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the other tribes of Israel

original.text: וַֽיִּגְּשׁ֗וּ רָאשֵׁי֙ אֲב֣וֹת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶל אֶלְעָזָר֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן נ֑וּן וְאֶל רָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: They spoke to them at Shiloh in land of Canaan, saying, YHWH commanded by hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with their pasturelands for our livestock.

familiar.text: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.

modern.text: at Shiloh in the land of Canaan and said to them, “The LORD commanded through Moses that we be given cities in which to live, together with pasturelands for our livestock.”

original.text: וַיְדַבְּר֨וּ אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם בְּשִׁלֹ֗ה בְּאֶ֤רֶץ כְּנַ֨עַן֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהוָה֙ צִוָּ֣ה בְיַד מֹשֶׁ֔ה לָֽתֶת לָ֥נוּ עָרִ֖ים לָשָׁ֑בֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֖ן לִבְהֶמְתֵּֽנוּ

verses.restored: Children of Israel gave to Levites from their inheritance, according to mouth of YHWH, these cities and their pasturelands.

familiar.text: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the LORD, these cities and their suburbs.

modern.text: So by the command of the LORD, the Israelites gave the Levites these cities and their pasturelands out of their own inheritance:

original.text: וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל לַלְוִיִּ֛ם מִנַּחֲלָתָ֖ם אֶל פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֶת הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְאֶת מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן

verses.restored: Lot came out for clans of Kohathites; sons of Aaron the priest, from Levites, had by lot thirteen cities from tribe of Judah, tribe of Simeon, and tribe of Benjamin.

familiar.text: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.

modern.text: The first lot came out for the Kohathite clans. The Levites who were descendants of Aaron the priest received thirteen cities by lot from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.

original.text: וַיֵּצֵ֥א הַגּוֹרָ֖ל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֑י וַיְהִ֡י לִבְנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִן הַלְוִיִּ֗ם מִמַּטֵּ֣ה יְ֠הוּדָה וּמִמַּטֵּ֨ה הַשִּׁמְעֹנִ֜י וּמִמַּטֵּ֤ה בִנְיָמִן֙ בַּגּוֹרָ֔ל עָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵֽה

verses.restored: Remaining sons of Kohath had by lot ten cities from clans of tribe of Ephraim, tribe of Dan, and half tribe of Manasseh.

familiar.text: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.

modern.text: The remaining descendants of Kohath received ten cities by lot from the tribes of Ephraim, Dan, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

original.text: וְלִבְנֵ֨י קְהָ֜ת הַנּוֹתָרִ֗ים מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת מַטֵּֽה אֶ֠פְרַיִם וּֽמִמַּטֵּה דָ֞ן וּמֵחֲצִ֨י מַטֵּ֧ה מְנַשֶּׁ֛ה בַּגּוֹרָ֖ל עָרִ֥ים עָֽשֶׂר

verses.restored: Sons of Gershon had by lot thirteen cities from clans of tribe of Issachar, tribe of Asher, tribe of Naphtali, and half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

familiar.text: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

modern.text: The descendants of Gershon received thirteen cities by lot from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

original.text: וְלִבְנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁ֗וֹן מִמִּשְׁפְּח֣וֹת מַטֵּֽה יִשָּׂשכָ֣ר וּמִמַּטֵּֽה אָ֠שֵׁר וּמִמַּטֵּ֨ה נַפְתָּלִ֜י וּ֠מֵחֲצִי מַטֵּ֨ה מְנַשֶּׁ֤ה בַבָּשָׁן֙ בַּגּוֹרָ֔ל עָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵֽה

verses.restored: Sons of Merari according to their clans had twelve cities from tribe of Reuben, tribe of Gad, and tribe of Zebulun.

familiar.text: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

modern.text: And the descendants of Merari received twelve cities from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.

original.text: לִבְנֵ֨י מְרָרִ֜י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֗ם מִמַּטֵּ֨ה רְאוּבֵ֤ן וּמִמַּטֵּה גָד֙ וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֔ן עָרִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה

verses.restored: Children of Israel gave these cities and their pasturelands by lot to Levites, as YHWH commanded by hand of Moses.

familiar.text: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

modern.text: So the Israelites allotted to the Levites these cities, together with their pasturelands, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.

original.text: וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶת הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְאֶת מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁ֖ה בַּגּוֹרָֽל

verses.restored: They gave from tribe of sons of Judah and from tribe of sons of Simeon these cities that are called by name.

familiar.text: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name,

modern.text: From the tribes of Judah and Simeon, they designated these cities by name

original.text: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ מִמַּטֵּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּמִמַּטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֑וֹן אֵ֚ת הֶֽעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָ֥א אֶתְהֶ֖ן בְּשֵֽׁם

verses.restored: They belonged to sons of Aaron, from clans of Kohathites, from sons of Levi, for theirs was first lot.

familiar.text: Which the children of Aaron, being of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi, had: for theirs was the first lot.

modern.text: to the descendants of Aaron from the Kohathite clans of the Levites, because the first lot fell to them:

original.text: וַֽיְהִי֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן מִמִּשְׁפְּח֥וֹת הַקְּהָתִ֖י מִבְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֑י כִּ֥י לָהֶ֛ם הָיָ֥ה הַגּוֹרָ֖ל רִיאשֹׁנָֽה

verses.restored: They gave them Kiriath-arba, father of Anak, that is Hebron, in hill country of Judah, with its pasturelands around it.

familiar.text: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with the suburbs thereof round about it.

modern.text: They gave them Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), with its surrounding pasturelands, in the hill country of Judah. (Arba was the father of Anak.)

original.text: וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ לָהֶ֜ם אֶת קִרְיַת֩ אַרְבַּ֨ע אֲבִ֧י הָֽעֲנ֛וֹק הִ֥יא חֶבְר֖וֹן בְּהַ֣ר יְהוּדָ֑ה וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֖הָ סְבִיבֹתֶֽיהָ

verses.restored: But field of city and its villages they gave to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his possession.

familiar.text: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.

modern.text: But they had given the fields and villages around the city to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his possession.

original.text: וְאֶת שְׂדֵ֥ה הָעִ֖יר וְאֶת חֲצֵרֶ֑יהָ נָֽתְנ֛וּ לְכָלֵ֥ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּ֖ה בַּאֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ

verses.restored: To sons of Aaron the priest they gave city of refuge for manslayer, Hebron with its pasturelands, Libnah with its pasturelands,

familiar.text: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,

modern.text: So to the descendants of Aaron the priest they gave these cities, together with their pasturelands: Hebron, a city of refuge for the manslayer, Libnah,

original.text: וְלִבְנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֗ן נָֽתְנוּ֙ אֶת עִיר֙ מִקְלַ֣ט הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֶת חֶבְר֖וֹן וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ וְאֶת לִבְנָ֖ה וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ

verses.restored: Jattir with its pasturelands, Eshtemoa with its pasturelands,

familiar.text: And Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,

modern.text: Jattir, Eshtemoa,

original.text: וְאֶת יַתִּר֙ וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת אֶשְׁתְּמֹ֖עַ וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ

verses.restored: Holon with its pasturelands, Debir with its pasturelands,

familiar.text: And Holon with her suburbs, and Debir with her suburbs,

modern.text: Holon, Debir,

original.text: וְאֶת חֹלֹן֙ וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת דְּבִ֖ר וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ

verses.restored: Ain with its pasturelands, Juttah with its pasturelands, and Beth-shemesh with its pasturelands: nine cities from those two tribes.

familiar.text: And Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.

modern.text: Ain, Juttah, and Beth-shemesh—nine cities from these two tribes, together with their pasturelands.

original.text: וְאֶת עַ֣יִן וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֗הָ וְאֶת יֻטָּה֙ וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶת בֵּ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֣ים תֵּ֔שַׁע מֵאֵ֕ת שְׁנֵ֥י הַשְּׁבָטִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה

verses.restored: From tribe of Benjamin: Gibeon with its pasturelands, Geba with its pasturelands,

familiar.text: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with her suburbs, Geba with her suburbs,

modern.text: And from the tribe of Benjamin they gave them Gibeon, Geba,

original.text: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֔ן אֶת גִּבְע֖וֹן וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶת גֶּ֖בַע וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ

verses.restored: Anathoth with its pasturelands, and Almon with its pasturelands: four cities.

familiar.text: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities.

modern.text: Anathoth, and Almon—four cities, together with their pasturelands.

original.text: אֶת עֲנָתוֹת֙ וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת עַלְמ֖וֹן וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע

verses.restored: All cities of sons of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their pasturelands.

familiar.text: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.

modern.text: In all, thirteen cities, together with their pasturelands, were given to the priests, the descendants of Aaron.

original.text: כָּל עָרֵ֥י בְנֵֽי אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּֽהֲנִ֑ים שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה עָרִ֖ים וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן

verses.restored: For clans of sons of Kohath, Levites remaining from sons of Kohath, cities of their lot were from tribe of Ephraim.

familiar.text: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.

modern.text: The remaining Kohathite clans of the Levites were allotted these cities: From the tribe of Ephraim

original.text: וּלְמִשְׁפְּח֤וֹת בְּנֵֽי קְהָת֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם הַנּוֹתָרִ֖ים מִבְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֑ת וַֽיְהִי֙ עָרֵ֣י גֽוֹרָלָ֔ם מִמַּטֵּ֖ה אֶפְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: They gave them city of refuge for manslayer, Shechem with its pasturelands in hill country of Ephraim, Gezer with its pasturelands,

familiar.text: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with her suburbs,

modern.text: they were given Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim (a city of refuge for the manslayer), Gezer,

original.text: וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ לָהֶ֜ם אֶת עִ֨יר מִקְלַ֧ט הָרֹצֵ֛חַ אֶת שְׁכֶ֥ם וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֖הָ בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְאֶת גֶּ֖זֶר וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ

verses.restored: Kibzaim with its pasturelands, and Beth-horon with its pasturelands: four cities.

familiar.text: And Kibzaim with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs; four cities.

modern.text: Kibzaim, and Beth-horon—four cities, together with their pasturelands.

original.text: וְאֶת קִבְצַ֨יִם֙ וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת בֵּ֥ית חוֹרֹ֖ן וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע

verses.restored: From tribe of Dan: Elteke with its pasturelands, Gibbethon with its pasturelands,

familiar.text: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with her suburbs, Gibbethon with her suburbs,

modern.text: From the tribe of Dan they were given Elteke, Gibbethon,

original.text: וּמִמַּ֨טֵּה דָ֔ן אֶֽת אֶלְתְּקֵ֖א וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶֽת גִּבְּת֖וֹן וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ

verses.restored: Aijalon with its pasturelands, Gath-rimmon with its pasturelands: four cities.

familiar.text: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gathrimmon with her suburbs; four cities.

modern.text: Aijalon, and Gath-rimmon—four cities, together with their pasturelands.

original.text: אֶת אַיָּלוֹן֙ וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶת גַּת רִמּ֖וֹן וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע

verses.restored: From half tribe of Manasseh: Taanach with its pasturelands and Gath-rimmon with its pasturelands: two cities.

familiar.text: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs; two cities.

modern.text: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Taanach and Gath-rimmon—two cities, together with their pasturelands.

original.text: וּמִֽמַּחֲצִית֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אֶת תַּעְנַךְ֙ וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת גַּת רִמּ֖וֹן וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים שְׁתָּֽיִם

verses.restored: All cities were ten with their pasturelands for clans of remaining sons of Kohath.

familiar.text: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.

modern.text: In all, ten cities, together with their pasturelands, were given to the rest of the Kohathite clans.

original.text: כָּל עָרִ֥ים עֶ֖שֶׂר וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֑ן לְמִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת בְּנֵֽי קְהָ֖ת הַנּוֹתָרִֽים

verses.restored: To sons of Gershon, from clans of Levites, from half tribe of Manasseh they gave city of refuge for manslayer, Golan in Bashan with its pasturelands, and Beeshterah with its pasturelands: two cities.

familiar.text: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beeshterah with her suburbs; two cities.

modern.text: This is what the Levite clans of the Gershonites were given: From the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Golan in Bashan, a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Beeshterah—two cities, together with their pasturelands.

original.text: וְלִבְנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁוֹן֮ מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַלְוִיִּם֒ מֵחֲצִ֞י מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה אֶת עִיר֙ מִקְלַ֣ט הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֶת גלון בַּבָּשָׁן֙ וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶֽת בְּעֶשְׁתְּרָ֖ה וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים שְׁתָּֽיִם

verses.restored: From tribe of Issachar: Kishion with its pasturelands, Daberath with its pasturelands,

familiar.text: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishon with her suburbs, Dabareh with her suburbs,

modern.text: From the tribe of Issachar they were given Kishion, Daberath,

translation_notes: Levites initiate the petition by invoking Moses' command, showing that landless religious servants must still ask for concrete housing and pasturelands.
The cities are distributed among priestly Aaronites and other Kohathites, Gershonites, and Merarites across multiple tribes, dispersing Levitical presence rather than creating one territorial bloc.
Refuge cities are embedded inside the Levitical network, joining teaching/service with asylum and due process.
Pasturelands matter; nonterritorial inheritance does not mean disembodied spirituality or freedom from material needs.
City lists and totals vary in some textual traditions and require comparison with Chronicles and other witnesses.

The fulfillment formula in verses 43-45 is the book's theological summary and must be read in tension with the same book's repeated admissions of remaining peoples, forced labor, and unconquered land.
'Rest around' describes the narrator's covenant claim from Israel's perspective, not the full lived reality of displaced, subordinated, or surviving communities.
safety_note: Do not use Joshua 21 to deny material support to religious workers, erase refugees by spiritualizing refuge, or claim that fulfillment language cancels the suffering of conquered peoples. Center housing, pasture, distributed service, asylum, and the need to read triumph summaries beside unresolved human realities.
